page.layout: No printed page: this scan shows the front cover of the binding (blind-tooled pigskin or vellum with a central panel, borders and two metal clasps). Outside the book: the Herzog August Bibliothek banner, a grey scale and a catalogue footer, which are left out.
page.notes: Front board of the binding, not a printed leaf. The central panel and small tooled lettering on the cover (faint, partly rubbed, mostly unreadable at this resolution) are blind-tooling, not printed text, so they are not transcribed. Library banner, grey scale and URL footer omitted per the digitiser rule.
